texts.text:
Be sure the Robot Odyssey I disk
is in the drive.

Then press ESC.

To go back to the room you just
left, press RETURN.

A thruster moves a robot
in the direction opposite
its thrust.

When the left thruster is
on, the robot moves RIGHT.

When the right thruster is
on, the robot moves LEFT.

What happens when the top
or bottom thruster is on?

In ROBOT ANATOMY, you'll learn
how to move, handle objects,
and how robots:

You can move in small steps.
Press the CONTROL key and
I, J, K, or M at the same time.

When a robot part is activated,
electricity flows OUT of its
output.
To continue, press RETURN.
Robot Anatomy

You are this
cursor.

This is a robot.
You can go inside it.

To go inside, line yourself
up with one of the robot's
white BUMPERS and move in
slowly. It may take a few
tries.

Go inside and explore.  


Come back out and take
the robot with you.

You have come through a door
into a different room.


       Follow the path.

Use this ENERGY
CRYSTAL to recharge
dead batteries.

Take it inside the robot.
Pass it over the battery.
Notice how the battery level
fills with electricity.

This sentry is trapped.

To let it out, hold the key
by the HANDLE. Use small steps
to put the key in the lock.

Go this
way  -}

You can pick up and drop objects.

To pick up an object, move on 
top of it. Press SPACEBAR or the
joystick or mouse BUTTON.

When a robot touches a wall, its
bumper beeps and turns orange
with electricity.  Inside the
robot, the bumper's OUTPUT turns
on too.

Try it and see what happens.

Move the robot so ONLY
its top bumper touches
the top wall. Drop it.

When the robot touches
a wall, electricity flows
from the bumper to the 
thruster, propelling the
robot.

The ANTENNA control
inside a robot controls
the antenna outside.

When its INPUT is on, 
the robot antenna sends
signals to other robots,
wherever they may be.
Press ? for help or hints.

The crystal goes `dead" (white)
as its electricity drains.


Drop the crystal in the robot.
Take the robot with you.

When a robot antenna
receives signals, the 
antenna control's OUTPUT
turns on.

The robot next door is wired 
to pick up and carry an
object.

The robot is also wired
to follow walls.

Go inside the robot. Close
the switch. Move quickly
onto the eye and watch how
the robot works.

These are SENSORS. Use them 
inside robots to detect objects
that MATCH the sensor shape. Each
of these sensors detects energy 
crystals in a different way.

I
J K
 M

Go inside the robot. Notice
how the sensors are wired.

Come outside. Move the objects
and the robot to new locations.
Watch what happens.

You have learned a lot about
ROBOT ANATOMY.  Return to the
menu to learn more.

Bring the dead energy
crystal outside. Pass it
over the recharger. Watch
it fill with electricity.

Continue to take the robot
with you.

The SWITCH inside a robot
turns electricity flow to
the thrusters on or off.

Go inside and sit on the
switch. Press SPACEBAR to
open and close it.

Drop a triangle on the robot
above to make it let go of the
crystal. Look inside to see 
why it works.
~ START

This is an IN-SAME-ROOM sensor. 
It detects objects in 
the same room.

Inside a robot, it detects
objects in the same room
as the robot.

Place the square ON the sensor.
What happens when you let go?

When a robot grabs
an object, the 
grabber control's
OUTPUT turns on.

Pick up the sensor. Move it
around the crystal. Outputs
pointing in the DIRECTION of
the crystal turn on.

When a DIRECTIONAL sensor is
inside a robot, the OUTPUTS
turn on in the direction of the
object outside of the robot.

Next door is a robot wired
with three sensors. 

The sensors are wired to make
the robot:

^ beep when it contacts a
  square.

Thrusters work when the switch
is closed (orange). Open the
switch to save batteries. 

Leave the robot here.

Use this CRYSTAL RECHARGER
to recharge energy crystals.

^ move left or right toward 
  an energy crystal.

^ move down when a triangle
  is in the room.
Press ESC to return to the menu.
CONTROL-S   Turn sound on or off.
ESC   Return to menu.

This is a CONTACT sensor.
It detects objects that
touch it.

Inside a robot, it detects
objects that touch the robot's
BODY.

Take the DIRECTIONAL sensor into
the robot in the room upstairs
and try it out.

^ move

^ send signals

^ grab objects

^ detect objects

This is a DIRECTIONAL sensor.
It detects the direction of
an object in the same room.

Inside a robot, it detects
the direction of an object
in the robot's room.

There is also a BATTERY
inside a robot.

This robot can't move 
because its battery is 
dead.

When electricity flows IN to an
input, it turns on the robot part.

You can see electricity flow.
It is orange.
?   Get help or hints.

You can be inside a robot
 and still see outside.

 Go inside the robot. Sit
 on the robot's EYE to
 activate its periscope.

 Move off the eye to see
 inside the robot again.

Aha! A shortcut between the
beginning and end of ROBOT
ANATOMY!

Inside a robot are four
THRUSTERS.

You can propel robots by
making electricity flow
into the thrusters' INPUTS.

The GRABBER control inside
a robot controls the 
grabber outside the robot.

When the grabber control's
INPUT is on, the robot     
will grab an object that
touches the robot's body.

Note: Robots can't grab
objects held by you or
another robot.

~
BUMPER

(The object must be in the same
room as the robot.)

Pick up this key and move it
around. To drop it, press
SPACEBAR or the BUTTON again.

Take the key with you.
To move, use:

^ I,J,K,M keys

^ joystick

^ mouse

Follow the arrows.

This is an INPUT.

Some robot parts connect to
inputs. Go inside the robot
and see.

This is an OUTPUT.

Some robot parts connect to 
outputs. Go inside the
robot and see.

Sensors can't detect an
object that is held.
Pick up the triangle.
What happens?

You can put things inside
robots. You can even put
robots inside robots! 


Pick up the triangle.
Carry it inside the robot.
Drop it and come outside.

Come outside.

Take the robot with you
through the next few rooms.
